verdict.rationale: Firebase's own CLI documents exporting users from Firebase Auth, which covers one slice of the story: a first-party export path for auth data. Nothing in the evidence documents a full export of Firestore, Realtime Database or Storage, or says which formats exports use. The community note about using the database as a plain JSON store to stay portable is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented full-data export across Firestore/RTDB/Storage, confirmation that exports use open formats, migration/offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
